title: Riding the Booster with enhanced sound
summary: Footage from a camera on a Space Shuttle solid rocket booster from liftoff through descent, with audio enhanced by Skywalker Sound from the original camera microphones. The sound is real, not foley.
why: HN recommends it for its raw, mostly natural audio and for conveying the speeds and violence of a shuttle launch and booster descent.

quote.text: I immediately had to re-watch this pretty awesome video after reading the article
